title: Consciot Ceiling Fan With Light, 44" with Remote, Black

comparisons.notes: Same Consciot 44in 3-blade black fan with 1500LM dimmable LED (3000K/4000K/5000K), 6-speed reversible, damp-rated, low-ceiling; product photo matches the Woot image. In stock.

writeup: Woot has the Consciot 44-inch flush-mount ceiling fan in black, new, for $39.99. Walmart sells the same fan for $69.99. It has a dimmable 1500-lumen LED light with three color temperatures, a remote, a 6-speed reversible DC motor, and a damp rating for covered patios, which makes it a good fit for low ceilings.
